create_vertex_text_to_speech_request: create a VertexTextToSpeechRequest with text input, voice config, and audio encoding settings
run_vertex_audio_speech: run synchronous text-to-speech synthesis via Google Cloud Vertex AI and return binary audio content
run_async_vertex_audio_speech: run asynchronous text-to-speech synthesis via Google Cloud Vertex AI and return binary audio content
test_validate_vertex_input: test validate_vertex_input to ensure text or ssml is provided and SSML auto-detection works correctly
